title: SimilarWeb Traffic & Website Analytics Scraper
description: Get estimated website traffic, engagement, rankings, category, and channel shares. No API key is required for public-data mode. Optionally provide your own Similarweb API key for official API mode. Only domains that return real metrics are saved and charged.

apiKey.title: Similarweb API key
apiKey.description: Optional. Add your official Similarweb API key to use API mode. Leave empty to use no-key public-data mode. Official API mode consumes your Similarweb API credits.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Website domains to look up, for example openai.com. Enter domains without https:// or www.

maxResults.title: Max domains
maxResults.description: Maximum number of domains from the list to query. Start with 1 for a quick, low-cost test.

country.title: Country scope
country.description: Official API mode only. Use 'world' or a two-letter country code such as us, gb, or in. The value must be included in your Similarweb subscription.

startDate.title: Start month (YYYY-MM)
startDate.description: Official API mode only. Optional start month in YYYY-MM format.

endDate.title: End month (YYYY-MM)
endDate.description: Official API mode only. Optional end month in YYYY-MM format.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy (public-data fallback)
proxyConfiguration.description: Used only when the public Similarweb endpoint blocks the direct request by region. The default US Residential proxy gives the public sample the best chance of succeeding.
